title: About Path2GC and Gordon College
text:
Path2GC is a web application that assists students and prospective enrollees in the Gordon College enrollment process through an interactive chatbot. The chatbot provides real-time guidance, answers enrollment-related queries, and helps users navigate each step toward successful admission.

Gordon College (formerly Olongapo City Colleges) is a public educational institution established in 1999 and supervised by the City Government of Olongapo. Contact: (047) 222-4080, info@gordoncollege.edu.ph. Address: Olongapo City Sports Complex, Donor St., East Tapinac, Olongapo City 2200.

Student & Faculty Resources: GC-Lamp, GC-Student Portal, GC-Admission, GC-Health Check, GCES Evaluator's Portal, GCA Evaluator's Portal, GCA Dean's Portal.

Policies: Citizen's Charter, Website Policy, Data Privacy Policy, Rights of the Data Subjects, Responsibilities of the Data Subjects.
